Warning: Consuming this product can expose you to cadmium, which is known to the state of California to cause birth defects or other reproductive harm. For more information go to www.p65Warnings.ca.gov/food
Storage Information: Refrigeration not required. Store in a cool, dark, dry place. Top. Boost. Bake. Add to: cookies & trail mix; smoothies & ice cream.

Straight from Mother Nature  
A rare superfood made exclusively by bees that feast on the nectar of New Zealand's wild Manuka blossoms, our raw Manuka honey is one of Mother Earth's most delicious mysteries. Wedderspoon is committed to complete Manuka honey integrity, with every batch fully traceable from our South Island hives to your home. 
The kFACTOR mark guarantees that the pure Manuka honey in this jar is as close to its freshly harvested state of raw perfection as possible and independently verified to meet or exceed the MPI standards for monofloral Manuka honey. Never subjected to high heat processing, our smooth & flavorful Manuka is brimming with living enzymes & complex chemical compounds to empower your daily wellness. Bee your most vibrant self.

• kFACTOR Manuka honey is harvested & packed in New Zealand and independently tested to meet or exceed the MPI standards for authentic Manuka honey. Trust the kFACTOR to represent pure Manuka honey that is raw & unpasteurized, Non-GMO Project Verified & free of any glyphosate, preservatives, or added ingredients. 
• Wedderspoon trusts in the brilliance of our hardworking bees to make the world’s best Manuka honey. And we believe that this superfood is at peak perfection straight from the hive, just as Mother Nature intended. Between our colorful hives and your home, we strive to maintain the complex ecosystem of living enzymes & chemical compounds within our honey as much as humanly possible. Every jar of kFACTOR Manuka honey is guaranteed authentic, raw & unpasteurized. Any closer to the source, and you’ll need a ticket to New Zealand. And probably a bee-suit. 
• This delicious superfood honey has a multitude of uses in your home as a better-for-you alternative sweetener, in home ‘remedies’, as a natural companion to DIY beauty regimens, right off the teaspoon for energy and active lifestyles, and is perfect in warm water with lemon to start your day!
Raw Monofloral Manuka Honey
Do not feed to children under 12 months.
No need to refrigerate.

Share the simply delicious taste of Sabra Classic Hummus. This tub is perfect for snacking, cooking and passing around the table. Sabra is the hummus that brings you back to the basics—eating with your hands, talking face to face and sharing your day. This recipe is a classic—chickpeas (also known as garbanzo beans), creamy tahini and a touch of garlic. The flavor is smooth, tasty and satisfying. Everyone wins with Sabra hummus on the snack table. Enjoy this vegetable dip with your family. Share it over chips with your co-workers. Serve it as gluten free snacks to your cheering teammates. Just pop off the lid to share with all your friends because Sabra hummus brings people together. This vegan dip is gluten free, certified kosher and Non-GMO Project Verified. Sabra Classic Hummus dip is made with chickpeas grown by family farmers in the Pacific Northwest and blended with ingredients from around the world. With Sabra Hummus, it’s all about doing what tastes good.

In addition to Classic, Sabra offers hummus dip in a variety of irresistible savory flavors, including Roasted Garlic, Roasted Red Pepper and Roasted Pine Nut. The Classic Hummus and Roasted Red Pepper Hummus are also available in convenient on-the-go singles. For quick and easy hummus packs, try Sabra Snackers, a delightful combination of hummus with pretzels or pita chips. No matter the occasion, Sabra has a hummus snack for you.

The coffee you hold in your hand today is a product of patience. The patience of an organic coffee farmer growing the most complex, flavorful beans. Of a team taking the time to meticulously source and roast each batch to hit the exact flavor notes. And finally, the patience you show in brewing a cup of coffee best described as yours. We call it coffee with character. And we hope you love it as much as we do. Please satisfy your curiosity by visiting us on our website or on social media. We have lots of good stuff there. JimsOrganicCoffee.com. Certified organic by Oregon Tilth. Jim's Notes - We all love coffee. Its tantalizing aroma, how it brings a smile to our face, how it slows down our busy world. We've seen first hand the benefits of organic. From the inspiring farmers and their lush, biodiverse ecosystems to our cupping table where we select only the finest coffees. We take great pride in providing consistently amazing coffee and are truly grateful to be a small organic part of one's daily routine. Enjoy!
Organic Coffee Sweet Love Blend Whole Bean Dark.

Brew tips. We're the kind of people who read the sides of coffee bags. Looks like you are, too. For the sake of space, here are the basics: Use 2 tablespoons ground coffee per 6 oz cup. Use fresh, clean water. For storage, roll bag tight to expel air and seal top.

sections.bodyString: Grown and processed by the Oaxacan State Coffee Producers Network (CEPCO), this lovely coffee is roasted on the light side of medium to highlight its subtle milk chocolate, honey and citrus notes. Sunny side cup to wake you up.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Co., Fair Trade, Mexico Oaxaca, Whole Bean Coffee

sections.bodyString: Single origin, Medium roast: For almost a decade, Brooklyn Roasting Company has purchased fair trade certified green coffee from the Sol Y Cafe cooperative in the foothills of the Andes in northern Peru. This highly respected cooperative’s commitment to quality control and improved community standards of living comes across loud and clear. Sol y Café members regularly win quality competitions within Peru and abroad. In the cup, this medium plus roast is balanced and sweet with a hint of toasted walnut and burnt cookie in the flavor and finish.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Co., Fair Trade, Peru Sol Y Café, Whole Bean Coffee

sections.bodyString: The best high-grown Guatemalan coffees originate in the Antigua and Huehuetenango regions. The rich volcanic soil and longer growing season yields very dense coffees. This outstanding example is superbly balanced, with smoky chocolate notes and a hint of crisp green apple. Grown under the shade of guava, plantain and banana trees, this coffee is fair trade certified.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Co., Fair Trade, Guatemala, Whole Bean Coffee

sections.bodyString: Ethiopian naturally processed coffees are among the most flavorful and exotic in the world. These are also called sun-dried coffees and tend to have fruitier, more surprising flavors than washed coffees. (Kind of like the difference between ales and lagers in the world of beer). The Banko Gotiti Cooperative in the southern district of Gedeb, Ethiopia, is a member of the Yirgacheffe Coffee Union and produces extraordinary old heirloom varietals. We roast these beans on the lighter side, imparting just enough roast to complement their delicate floral character.

name: Brooklyn Roasting Co., Fair Trade, Ethiopia Banko Gotiti, Whole Bean Coffee

Farro is one of our most popular ancient grains and a relative of modern-day wheat. It was a mainstay of the daily diet in ancient Rome and is still a popular food and ingredient in Italy today. Farro is hearty and chewy, with a rich, nutty flavor. Use in soups, casseroles, salads and pilafs.

Organic Pearled Farro
Contains: wheat.

Basic Cooking Instructions: Stovetop: Bring 2 quarts water to a boil in a pot with 1 tsp salt. Add 1 cup rinsed farro, return to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-high and boil uncovered until soft, about 30 minutes. Drain off cooking water, then serve. Pre-Soak Method: Cover 1 cup farro with water and soak in the refrigerator overnight, then drain. Place in a pot and add 3 cups water or stock (enough to cover the grains). Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes. Drain excess liquid and serve. Slow Cooker: Place 1 cup rinsed farro, 4 cups water and 1 tsp salt into a slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 2-2½ hours or high for 1½ hours. Drain excess water and serve. Multi-Cooker: Place 1 cup rinsed farro, 3 cups water and 1 tsp salt in the pot of a multi-cooker. Set the valve to sealing. On manual setting and high pressure, set for 12 minutes. Quick release the pressure. Drain excess water and serve. Makes 4 servings (about 2 cups). Excellent in soups, casseroles, salads and pilafs. Store in a cool, dry place. Tear to open.

To make up Colman's Powder Mustard to serve as a simple condiment with food, only cold water should be used. Mix with equal quantity of water and allow ten minutes standing time to allow the full flavour to develop. The water acts as a catalyst that helps yield essential oil of mustard which produces that unmistakable taste. The strength of flavour diminishes with time so we recommend that you make your mustard fresh each time.
